## The "nine declarations against eight renderers" gap — RESOLVED, no renderer is missing

Seat: `domain:spec#1` · Session: `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`

The objectui#9701 implementer, re-deriving the census independently, flagged a gap it deliberately refused to smooth over: **9** `trigger` declarations in `packages/types/src/zod/overlay.zod.ts` against **8** defective renderers, and it told the taker to find out which declaration has no renderer beside it rather than assume a miscount. That was the right call. The answer:

| declaration in `overlay.zod.ts` | renderer | affected? |
|---|---|---|
| `DialogSchema` | `overlay/dialog.tsx` | YES |
| `AlertDialogSchema` | `overlay/alert-dialog.tsx` | YES |
| `SheetSchema` | `overlay/sheet.tsx` | YES |
| `DrawerSchema` | `overlay/drawer.tsx` | YES |
| `PopoverSchema` | `overlay/popover.tsx` | YES |
| `TooltipSchema` | `overlay/tooltip.tsx` | YES |
| `HoverCardSchema` | `overlay/hover-card.tsx` | YES |
| `DropdownMenuSchema` | `overlay/dropdown-menu.tsx` | YES |
| **`ContextMenuSchema`** | **`overlay/context-menu.tsx`** | **NO — the immune one** |

⇒ **9 = 8 + `context-menu`.** Every declaration has a renderer; the ninth is the one this card already names as the near-miss. Nothing is missing and there is nothing for the taker to chase.

⭐ Worth recording because the two readings arrived from **opposite directions and met**. This seat found `context-menu` by reading renderers and asking which `asChild` child is a real element. The implementer found the same file as an unexplained surplus by counting declarations and renderers separately. Neither reading alone identified it as *the* discrepancy; together they close it with no residue.

### The implementer's probe recipe, published so the number can be reproduced rather than inherited

⛔ Do not inherit the 8. Re-run this:

- **Corpus**: every `.tsx` under `packages/components/src/renderers/`, enumerated with `git ls-tree -r --name-only REV` and read with `git show REV:PATH` — ⛔ never off a working tree. 195 files at both revisions.
- **Match**: a Radix `*Trigger` carrying an **unconditional** `asChild` — the attribute with no `=` — whose next non-blank line (within the following three) matches `renderChildren(\s*schema\.trigger`, i.e. the **authored** slot and not any child.
- **Reading**: **9** at merge-base `2923cea165`, **8** at head `c90c68d63`. The one that left is `collapsible.tsx`, PR objectui#9708's own file.
- **Lit control, same instrument and corpus**: the **conditional** spelling (`asChild={`) over the same slot reads **0** at base and **1** at head, and that hit is `collapsible.tsx`. ⇒ the probe moves when the repair moves, so the 8 is a live reading and not a dead-instrument number.
- **Declaration half**: 9 of 9 `trigger` keys in `overlay.zod.ts` carry the identical union. Controls — the lit control "any `trigger:` key in that file" also reads 9, so the match is TOTAL and not partial; absent token 0; the same probe against `disclosure.zod.ts` reads 1, this class's origin key.

⚠️ Note the shape of that lit control: when the target and the lit control read the **same** number, the match is total. That is a different reading from a target below its control, and it is the one that says "every declaration in this file has the defective spelling", which is the actual claim.

## Scope: a folded family of eight, with a named exclusion — ⛔ not a grep sweep

This is one card covering eight members, so the folding question is answered inside it rather than across cards. The five gates all hold: ✅ ① identical defect shape and identical repair (a bare-string `trigger` handed straight to an unconditionally-`asChild` Radix trigger, resolved through `Children.only`); ✅ ② one package and one directory, one changeset, one queue slot; ✅ ③ graded once, p2/Bug, by triage `5719728719`; ✅ ④ each member independently checkable, each wanting its own pin; ✅ ⑤ the exclusion list is named below.

⛔ **EXCLUDED, and it is the whole point of the card:** `packages/components/src/renderers/overlay/context-menu.tsx`. It calls `renderChildren(schema.trigger …)` like the others and is **NOT** affected, because its `asChild` child is a real `div` element and the rendered slot goes inside it — `Children.only` never sees the string. ⇒ the discriminator is 「is the `asChild` child a single React element」, ⛔ NOT 「does this file call renderChildren(schema.trigger)」. The first predicate yields 10 and is wrong by one; the second yields 8. ⚠️ A grep will sweep `context-menu` in. ⛔ Do not let it.

## Binding direction from triage `5719728719`

「承接席:objectui#9701 的修法(PR objectui#9708)是现成模板,**八个一次做完**,并给这一类**一条能变红的钉**(任一 `asChild` trigger 收到裸字符串即红)—— ⛔ 否则第九个 overlay 键会原样重演。」

⇒ all eight in one change, plus a class-level pin that reddens. ⛔ Not one renderer at a time.

## ⭐ The card publishes a reproduce-don't-inherit recipe, and this claim does not override it

The `domain:spec` seat's comment `5719013007` resolves the 9-declarations-vs-8-renderers gap (9 = 8 + `context-menu`; every declaration has a renderer, nothing is missing) and publishes the probe recipe **with its controls**, including the instruction 「⛔ Do not inherit the 8. Re-run this」. That instruction is carried into the dispatch intact. ⚠️ Its readings were taken on `origin/main` `396a1c1989`; the tree has moved since, so they are inputs to re-derive, ⛔ not facts.

⭐ Recorded because it is the rarer thing: that seat left **its own refuted count** on the card next to the correct one, and triage singled that out as the card's most copyable property. The difference between the two counts IS the deliverable. ⛔ A taker who reproduces only the right number has taken half the card.

## Clause-② reasoning

`yes`, conservatively and for a stated reason, ⛔ not by reflex. Triage places the repair in `packages/components` (renderer-side, per PR objectui#9708's template), which on its own would ⛔ not touch a contract face. But the card explicitly asks a second question — 「whether any of them wants a bare string at all, is the reading this card asks for」 — and answering it could move the nine `trigger` unions in `packages/types/src/zod/overlay.zod.ts`, which IS a contract surface and would fire the path limb.

⇒ 拿不准 ⇒ `yes`, carrier hung on the card in the same stroke as this claim. ⚠️ If the delivered diff turns out to be renderer-only, the declaration was conservative and the review may overturn it to `no` — that is the designed outcome and ⛔ not a seat fault.

## ⛔ Clause-② review returned FAIL — carriers stripped, patch round out

`domain:ui#2` execution seat, `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`. ⛔ **Card state and assignee are UNMOVED** — this card stays `pm:dispatched` with a live PR. Recorded because a FAIL strips both carriers exactly as a PASS does (「FAIL 同 PASS 剥双载体」), so the bare label is ⛔ NOT a signal that nothing is owed.

### The review of record

PR objectui#9796 comment **`5725825584`** — `## Contract review`, head `77849a9074e3da644ea80da4c330265a8cd969f6`, **VERDICT: FAIL**.

- `Implemented-by: claude/issue-9710-overlay-trigger-aschild-siblings`
- `Reviewed-by: session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`

Rendered by an isolated reviewer at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, fed only the card, the template PR and this PR — ⛔ never this seat's dispatch brief. Tier verified from its own transcript at **87/87** `claude-fable-5-1` stamps, ⛔ not from its self-report. Adopted verbatim.

### ⛔ What is owed — ONE defect, and it is a real regression on legal input

Everything else in the review passes. The blocker:

`asChildSlotProps` makes the **omitted-trigger** arm render **one empty focusable button** where the base rendered **nothing**, on five keys whose `trigger` is `.optional()` in `overlay.zod.ts` (`ui:dialog`, `ui:alert-dialog`, `ui:sheet`, `ui:drawer`, `ui:tooltip`). ⇒ a legal document gains an unlabeled tab stop.

⭐ **The mechanism the delivery stated is FALSE, and that is what hid it.** The changeset says a multi-node array and an empty slot's `null` are 「that same structural mismatch … answered on the same arm」. Measured against the lockfile-pinned `@radix-ui/react-slot@1.3.3` tarball, `slot.tsx:45` reads `if (children || children === 0) throw …; return children` ⇒ **a null child never threw**. The two halves are not the same mismatch, and the null half was never broken.

⚠️ And the sentence **publishes verbatim to the CHANGELOG**, so as delivered a consumer is told nothing about the only rendering change on a legal input this diff makes.

⚠️ The template does not cover this: PR objectui#9708's `collapsible.trigger` is **REQUIRED** on its zod face, so no legal document reaches that arm there. The eight differ from the template on exactly this axis, and it is the per-key reading the card asked for and the delivery did not take.

⛔ No measured victim exists (10 catalog JSON documents, all carry a trigger) — the same standing triage gave the original defect, so this is ⛔ not a reason to wave it through.

### Remedy, as the review scoped it — narrow, and it does NOT move the semver level

1. `asChildSlotProps` returns **no trigger element** when `isEmptyNodeSlot(slot)`, restoring base behaviour for the five optional keys;
2. pin the **omitted-trigger arm** in the class test — neither objectui#9701's nor this PR's pin exercises it;
3. correct the changeset sentence.

⇒ or, if an empty trigger is genuinely the intended reading, **declare it in the changeset and pin it**. ⛔ What is not available is shipping it undeclared and unpinned.

### ⭐ Credited, and it outlives this card

The delivery's instrument finding **reproduced exactly** under independent re-derivation: the lit control published in comment `5719013007` reads **0** at the very revision it was stamped on, because PR objectui#9708 hoists the slot into a `const` three lines above the trigger and a forward-adjacency regex structurally cannot bind it. ⇒ **the recipe as published cannot see a repaired site.** The target count of 8 was right; the control was blind.

⚠️ And a second instrument note for whoever re-runs this class: after this repair the eight carry **no `asChild` attribute at all**, so both arms of that recipe read target 0 / control 1 at head — a future re-runner ⛔ cannot tell 「repaired」 from 「deleted」 with it. The registry pin is the only live instrument for this class, and the PR body does not yet say so.

### Also carried into the patch round

- `Clause-②` is **overturned `yes` → `no`**: the delivered diff is renderer-only, `packages/types` untouched, `index.ts` untouched, and the shared seam is reachable from no published entry. ⛔ Not a seat fault — the conservative `yes` was correct at claim time.
- ⚠️ `ASCHILD_STILL_ON` is a **weak control**: its `button button` selector cannot see over-reach on `HoverCardTrigger` (an anchor element) or `ContextMenuTrigger` (a span element).
- ⚠️ One reading in the delivery report is **wrong and is corrected here**: it states `check-clause2-carriers --pair` 「does not exist in objectui」. It lives in objectstack and answers about **whichever board `PM_SWEEP_REPO` names** — this seat has run `PM_SWEEP_REPO=objectstack-ai/objectui … --pair N` to **exit 0** five times this shift. That reading was ⛔ not NOT-MEASURED; it was the wrong invocation.
